title: Perform Find inside Loop
description: Performance rule — Perform Find steps executed inside a Loop. Every iteration triggers a full find.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A Perform Find inside a Loop re-queries the database on every iteration.
rule.remediation: Move the find out of the loop, or replace it with a relationship / ExecuteSQL lookup.
